_comment: Edad Biologica es un SCORE derivado, no un biomarcador medido. Esta entrada es solo un placeholder de catalogo (existe en Function Health) -- NO implementa ningun modelo ni formula. Segun la Fase 3 del roadmap, cuando se construya un modelo real (BiologicalAgeModelV1) necesitara su propia entidad con formula/inputs/model/version, no solo este esquema de Biomarker. No calcular esto con un LLM.

knowledge_card.biological_role: An estimate of how old your body behaves, calculated from 9 routine blood markers and your age.
knowledge_card.clinical_relevance: Tracks whether lifestyle changes move your overall health profile in the right direction.
knowledge_card.preanalytical_factors: All the markers it uses: glucose, CRP, albumin, creatinine, blood count and others.
knowledge_card.limitations: A population-level estimate, not a diagnosis; small changes are within error.

references.title: Levine ME et al. An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan. Aging (Albany NY) 2018
